interpretation_rules.numeric_owner: Historical source occupation/category, never individual user.
interpretation_rules.source_terminology: The original source column uses automation_probability; retaining that field for provenance does not authorize personal or current risk interpretation.

crosswalk_selection.explanation: V4 contains valid FROZEN v1/v2/v3/v4-introduced rows. crosswalk_version==v4.0 is NOT a valid selection filter.
crosswalk_selection.authorization_metadata: Actual CSV uses mapping_status; do not invent a universal decision/adjudication_status column. Where supplemental decision/adjudication metadata exists, preserve and validate against the freeze manifest without requiring such fields on earlier rows.

source_value_validation.range_basis: Observed and validated pinned local CSV domain; range is not a calibration or current-risk claim.
requirements: Parse numeric without changing numerical value.
Preserve original cell representation for reconstruction.
Use explicit missingness and validity checks, never truthiness; numeric zero is valid.
Empty, nonnumeric, NaN, infinity or out-of-range cell produces UNAVAILABLE_SOURCE_EXPOSURE_VALUE, not numerical zero.

candidate_selection.TOP: Use frozen selected top_onet_soc_code/title; preserve inference status and source evidence. Do not choose a new SOC based on exposure availability.
candidate_selection.MULTIPLE: Return every unique SOC with candidate_eligible == 'TRUE' from the frozen audit for the profile; retain original row rank/evidence metadata, including unmapped SOCs.
candidate_selection.INSUFFICIENT: Gate before any crosswalk or source-value lookup; no exposure candidate result. Eligible audit count/diagnostic evidence does not override abstention.
candidate_selection.coverage_rule: For MULTIPLE, mapped numerator counts eligible SOCs having at least one valid valued FROZEN source path; denominator is ALL eligible SOCs. Preserve unmapped SOCs. For TOP denominator is selected SOC 1; for INSUFFICIENT no lookup coverage denominator.
candidate_selection.source_records_rule: For each mapped/frozen SOC, retain every source edge including individually unavailable values. A candidate may be mapped if at least one source value is valid; individual missing sources retain reasons and do not disappear.
candidate_selection.partial_source_coverage: A SOC with some valid and some invalid source paths retains candidate mapped availability plus each source value_available/unavailable_reason. Source ambiguity is an orthogonal flag, not a seventh primary state.

source_identity_safeguards.one_SOC_multiple_sources: Retain every frozen source record, flag ambiguity if multiple sources, no selection or averaging; currently zero SOCs with multiple FROZEN sources in V4.
source_identity_safeguards.multiple_SOCs_one_source: Preserve source IDs and shared_with_modern_socs across the complete graph; repeated values from the same source are not independent measurements.
source_identity_safeguards.shared_source_deduplication: A display may identify common source identity, but must not drop eligible SOCs, merge occupations or create an aggregate.

manual_confirmation.timestamp_rule: Actual future action time only; null before an action; never backfill.

checks: Validate pinned artifact hashes and required schemas before dependent evaluation.
Validate identifiers/title correspondence, row consistency, supported mapping states and the complete graph.
Validate inference state/eligible-count contract; MULTIPLE must have a nonempty eligible set; TOP selected SOC must be supported by frozen inference.
Validate value cells per source; recoverable invalid cell gives UNAVAILABLE_SOURCE_EXPOSURE_VALUE, missing source identity/title mismatch is artifact failure.
Duplicate identical audit evidence may retain all row references without double-counting SOCs; conflicting identities or ranks require validation error.

legacy_application_boundary.required_before_application_integration: Isolate or retire legacy CV-text risk predictor/fallback logic; new Step 7B results must never silently populate, fall back to or be conflated with risk_score.
legacy_application_boundary.audit_basis: User supplied independent Astra read-only audit finding; legacy application code was not executed or modified in this contract step.

chain_B: user skill evidence + chosen occupation requirements

known_limitations: Historical source-taxonomy correspondence and exact inclusion boundaries have limitations.
Modern O*NET mapping does not make a historical value current.
Complete local source/Wocke extraction lineage has not been independently reproduced; reference code/title verification is a separate claim.
Historical occupation-level exposure is not current generative-AI risk, personal automation probability or probability of losing a job.
US-origin reference evidence may not generalize to other labor markets.
Coverage is data availability, not accuracy, semantic equivalence or inference confidence.
TOP inference does not verify current employment; CV role chronology may remain unresolved.
EQUIVALENT retains recorded scope/current-historical limitations; broader and overlap values are contextual source references.

baseline_coverage_validation.denominator_rule: 179 is audit inventory; 170 enters active lookup; nine insufficient-only SOCs do not enter lookup. Never describe both denominators as active SOCs.

independent_audit.basis: User-supplied report of independent GPT-6-Astra High read-only audit; this task encodes required constraints and does not claim to rerun that audit.

prohibited_behaviors: Numerical defaults for unavailable exposure, including zero
Profile exposure averaging, weighting, median, min/max scoring or other aggregation
Rank-1 selection for MULTIPLE or discarding unmapped eligible SOCs
Treating inference scores, rank, mapping confidence or coverage fractions as probabilities
Transforming source values by CV skills, user characteristics, score or confidence
INSUFFICIENT historical lookup, including diagnostic TOP and eligible/rejected audit candidates
Individual job-loss or current generative-AI displacement probability
Legacy risk_score fallback or silent population
Skill-gap scoring or reskilling implementation in this step
